tools.name: check_charities
tools.description: Look up UK registered charities by charity number and say which can take a gift through Legacy. Gives our name for each number, so you can confirm it is the charity the donor meant.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: What a gift to these charities comes to: what the donor pays, the payment processing fee, each charity’s share and, if asked, the Gift Aid they could claim. The donor chooses Gift Aid and any tip at checkout, so these are assumptions.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: A link to Legacy’s checkout with these charities, and the amounts when given. The donor opens it to give their details, answer Gift Aid, choose an optional tip and pay by card; the amounts stay theirs to change.
